access_policies_combination_check.name: access_policies_combination_check
access_policies_combination_check.value: ("rentnerproxy"."access_policies"."mode" = 'combined' and "rentnerproxy"."access_policies"."combination" is not null) or ("rentnerproxy"."access_policies"."mode" <> 'combined' and "rentnerproxy"."access_policies"."combination" is null)

certificate_jobs_secret_check.name: certificate_jobs_secret_check
certificate_jobs_secret_check.value: ("rentnerproxy"."certificate_binding_jobs"."request_ciphertext" is null and "rentnerproxy"."certificate_binding_jobs"."request_iv" is null) or ("rentnerproxy"."certificate_binding_jobs"."request_ciphertext" is not null and "rentnerproxy"."certificate_binding_jobs"."request_iv" is not null and octet_length("rentnerproxy"."certificate_binding_jobs"."request_ciphertext") between 17 and 65536 and octet_length("rentnerproxy"."certificate_binding_jobs"."request_iv") = 12)

certificates_environment_check.name: certificates_environment_check
certificates_environment_check.value: ("rentnerproxy"."certificates"."source" = 'manual' and "rentnerproxy"."certificates"."environment" is null) or ("rentnerproxy"."certificates"."source" = 'acme' and "rentnerproxy"."certificates"."environment" is not null and "rentnerproxy"."certificates"."environment" in ('staging', 'production'))

certificates_validity_check.name: certificates_validity_check
certificates_validity_check.value: "rentnerproxy"."certificates"."status" != 'valid' or ("rentnerproxy"."certificates"."issued_at" is not null and "rentnerproxy"."certificates"."expires_at" is not null and "rentnerproxy"."certificates"."issued_at" < "rentnerproxy"."certificates"."expires_at" and "rentnerproxy"."certificates"."fingerprint" is not null)

host_check_incidents_closed_at_check.name: host_check_incidents_closed_at_check
host_check_incidents_closed_at_check.value: ("rentnerproxy"."host_check_incidents"."closed_reason" is null) = ("rentnerproxy"."host_check_incidents"."closed_at" is null) and ("rentnerproxy"."host_check_incidents"."closed_at" is null or "rentnerproxy"."host_check_incidents"."closed_at" >= "rentnerproxy"."host_check_incidents"."detected_at")

host_check_incidents_dates_check.name: host_check_incidents_dates_check
host_check_incidents_dates_check.value: "rentnerproxy"."host_check_incidents"."detected_at" >= "rentnerproxy"."host_check_incidents"."started_at" and ("rentnerproxy"."host_check_incidents"."recovery_started_at" is null or "rentnerproxy"."host_check_incidents"."recovery_started_at" >= "rentnerproxy"."host_check_incidents"."started_at") and ("rentnerproxy"."host_check_incidents"."recovered_at" is null or "rentnerproxy"."host_check_incidents"."recovered_at" >= "rentnerproxy"."host_check_incidents"."detected_at")

host_check_incidents_recovery_check.name: host_check_incidents_recovery_check
host_check_incidents_recovery_check.value: ("rentnerproxy"."host_check_incidents"."closed_reason" is not distinct from 'recovered' and "rentnerproxy"."host_check_incidents"."recovery_started_at" is not null and "rentnerproxy"."host_check_incidents"."recovered_at" is not null and "rentnerproxy"."host_check_incidents"."recovery_code" is not null) or ("rentnerproxy"."host_check_incidents"."closed_reason" is distinct from 'recovered' and "rentnerproxy"."host_check_incidents"."recovered_at" is null and "rentnerproxy"."host_check_incidents"."recovery_code" is null)

host_check_policies_retention_check.name: host_check_policies_retention_check
host_check_policies_retention_check.value: "rentnerproxy"."host_check_policies"."retention_days" between 1 and 30 and "rentnerproxy"."host_check_policies"."sample_limit" between 10 and 10000 and "rentnerproxy"."host_check_policies"."incident_limit" between 1 and 1000

host_check_policies_streaks_check.name: host_check_policies_streaks_check
host_check_policies_streaks_check.value: "rentnerproxy"."host_check_policies"."failure_count" between 0 and "rentnerproxy"."host_check_policies"."failure_threshold" and "rentnerproxy"."host_check_policies"."recovery_count" between 0 and "rentnerproxy"."host_check_policies"."recovery_threshold" and ("rentnerproxy"."host_check_policies"."failure_count" = 0) = ("rentnerproxy"."host_check_policies"."failure_started_at" is null) and ("rentnerproxy"."host_check_policies"."recovery_count" = 0) = ("rentnerproxy"."host_check_policies"."recovery_started_at" is null)

host_check_policies_context_check.name: host_check_policies_context_check
host_check_policies_context_check.value: ("rentnerproxy"."host_check_policies"."context_proof" is null and "rentnerproxy"."host_check_policies"."context_revision" is null) or ("rentnerproxy"."host_check_policies"."context_proof" is not null and "rentnerproxy"."host_check_policies"."context_revision" is not null and "rentnerproxy"."host_check_policies"."context_proof" ~ '^sha256:[a-f0-9]{64}$' and "rentnerproxy"."host_check_policies"."context_revision" ~ '^sha256:[a-f0-9]{64}$')
